answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in grove, expire in fable, and yarrow lists each expiry. An attacker running 68 aliases hence needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3518 identities would post 1305 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
